title: Page 10
content_zh:
账房里，连二十两银子都拿不出来，家里大事小事，包括童老爷在外的应酬，满院上下奴仆的吃喝月银，依靠童老爷一个人的俸禄根本不够用，就只能指望新夫人的嫁妆。
吃人嘴短，于是不必新夫人说什么，童家主仆全乖巧得不得了，甚至麻利又勤快，生怕表忠心晚了。
童芊芊闹了几次，可惜她在童老爷面前敌不过新夫人的眼泪，童老爷一出门，她的日子就越发不好过。
渐渐的，她终于知道低头了。
第二十二章 圆满过日子(2)
且不说，童家如何热闹，只说桂园里，日子照旧是甜蜜又安宁。
按理说，童悠悠是童家大小姐，这些丑事，她总要受几分影响。但之前童家百般苛待她，几乎是满城皆知的事，她出嫁之后，人人就下意识把她同童家切割开来。甚至，还有人因为替她觉得解恨。
药铺的名声越来越响，更受欢迎的居然是后边小院子的育儿培训。
子嗣永远是最被看重的，无论是高门大户还是普通百姓，特别是继承家业的男孩，若是家里没有一个顶门户的，以后财产都要被族人分割，出嫁的女儿也没有兄弟可以撑腰保护。
童悠悠先前在台州被关在童家大院，诸多限制，如今嫁做梁家媳妇儿可是彻底自由了。
上午坐堂诊脉，下午就亲自培训，晚上还要写教案或是编写简单育儿的小册子，忙碌不已，以至于梁浩海不知道抱怨多少次，还说出“悔叫妻子开药铺”的话，惹得童悠悠笑得肚子疼。
但是很快的，她就不得不减少工作量，因为……她怀了身孕！
梁浩海那日散衙回来，特意买了城东的驴肉火烧，开心的送给媳妇儿吃个新鲜，结果却让童悠悠吐个半死。
医者不自医，当即梁浩海就快马去太医院抢了个太医回来，这才得知这一喜讯。
夫妻俩当时就欢喜傻了，不知太医什么时候被送走，等徐大娘和徐夫人抱了胖小子赶到，他们才算清醒过来。
梁浩海又去宫里请假，缠磨着皇上要休假一年，他打算专心陪着妻子怀孕生产。
结果不必说，皇上重重数落了他一顿，但也给他带回来满满一车的补品，外加半个月的假期。
童悠悠虽然专治妇科，却是第一次怀孕，心里忐忑激动，花了好几日才算平静下来。
这还多亏了徐家妯娌和胖小子，他们几乎是日日登门，让她心里感到温暖，自然就没了忐忑。她虽然祖母过世，母亲早亡，有娘家同没有一般，但徐家却是比亲人待她更好。
如今她又孕育着自己的血脉，夫妻恩爱，她已经是旁人羡慕到眼红的女人了。

寒冷的冬天，就在童悠悠吃了睡，睡了吃，养猪一般养胎的日子中过去了。
药铺那边，她每三日才能过去一趟，还必须由梁浩海跟随这才能出门，否则，桂园上下会跑出一百人劝她留下。
幸好，梁浩海很了解她，不能去药铺的日子，桂园就会开门迎客，一日两位，童悠悠帮她们看诊，她们则顺带给童悠悠解闷。
若说年前年后京都最大的八卦，除了安南侯府大少爷转性，从风流公子变成绝世好夫君，再没别的了。
过了年，北风一日暖过一日，融化了冬雪，欣欣向荣的春天也就到了。
农人们忙着耕种，城里街路也更热闹。
一眨眼就是炎热的夏初，吃过端午的粽子，刚刚迈进七月，童悠悠就发动了。
她平日不少走动，饮食健康得法，虽然是第一胎，但一个时辰就顺利生了出来。
一个七斤半的大胖丫头，赶在七月七的清晨来到了人间，注定掉进了福坑里。
徐家的小子是七月初八早晨，梁家的姑娘早了一日，被所有人都说是缘分。
七月七乞巧节，梁家姑娘的乳名是现成的，巧儿二字最适合了。
徐夫人抱了巧儿不撒手，见她双眉之间的红痣，怎么看怎么觉得喜气，连连赞道：“这是观音痣啊，这孩子长大一定像她娘一般心善，聪慧。”
前来参加洗三礼的妇人们也纷纷点头，称赞不停，有动心的，开口试探几句。
徐夫人立刻开始护犊子，“巧儿同我家小子生辰只差一天，太有缘分了，我可是预定了她做儿媳，你们可不能同我抢。”
虽然童悠悠待徐家同娘家一般，但到底没有血缘，两家若是结亲家也不算错了规矩。众人没有借口，只能眼睁睁看着人家亲上加亲。
童悠悠也没拦着，一来徐家胖小子的性子不错，徐家更是同她感情深厚，女儿若是长大，嫁去徐家绝对不会受委屈。这个世界，同她的前世大有不同，对于女子来说，情爱反倒在其次，如何一辈子不受委屈，生活得舒心自在更不容易。
更何况，未来日子长了，两个孩子就算看不对眼，再另外安排也不迟。
梁浩海得了个胖闺女，没有外人想象中失望，反倒欢喜得疯了一般，刚出满月，就亲自抱了闺女去宫里讨赏。
皇上皇后，甚至是太后那里都没放过。
而巧儿也争气，才出满月的孩子，长得白胖可爱，大眼水灵灵，樱桃小嘴红润润，见人就笑不说，到了太后宫里，见到太后居然双手抱着拜了一拜，惹得太后宫里太监宫女跪了一地，直说，这丫头是观音座下童女下凡，见到太后就拜主子呢。

太后被哄得激动不已，不但赏赐了足足三车的东西，还亲自同皇上讨要了一个郡主封号，赐名明月。
消息传出去，不知道多少人羡慕得红了眼睛。
特别是安南侯府，安南侯也有嫡女，但请封县主的折子递上去几年了，皇上没有批覆。而桂园这边，一个刚出生的小丫头片子直接就封了明月郡主，真是人比人比死人，货比货货得扔。
可羡慕归羡慕，嫉妒就继续嫉妒，却没人敢说一句难听的。因为这小丫头如今在皇上那里挂了号，更是太后娘娘的新宠，谁敢惹啊！
桂园里，童悠悠抱了闺女，把她喂得饱足，梁浩海这个女儿奴就赶紧把闺女接了过去，让闺女竖着趴在肩头上，轻轻拍嗝。
待小丫头打了个饱嗝，他就好似闺女拯救了全世界一般，骄傲得连声夸赞，恨不得人人皆知闺女这一辉煌战果。
童悠悠实在看不下去，好好一个侍卫统领变成傻子，赶紧把闺女交给柳嫂子抱下去。
梁浩海舍不得的目送闺女出了门，这才转身抱住媳妇儿，不知道的还以为他多黏媳妇儿，其实不过是填补闺女剩下的空荡怀抱。
童悠悠这么好的脾气，都忍不住吃醋，大大翻了个白眼，惹得梁浩海大笑出声。
小夫妻俩笑闹几句，重新抱在一起，半晌没有说话，享受难得的幸福时刻。
童悠悠突然想起一事，就道：“前日满月酒宴，那边院子没来人，可是出了事？”
梁浩海自然知道她是指童家，“是有些小事儿，据说台州那位同亲闺女勾结，给新夫人的安胎药里下了些东西，差点儿让新夫人小产。童老爷大发雷霆，直接把闺女送去城外尼姑庵，至于台州那位，估计要重病不起了。”
童悠悠会意，所谓的重病不起，最后结果就是病故。
她真是不知道要怎么说那对母女，其实那位新夫人不见得有除掉她们的心思，只要她们安分，安静度日也不难，但偏偏她们不肯认输，才有了这样的结局。
content_en:
In the accounting room, even twenty taels of silver were not available. For all the big and small things at home, including Mr. Tong's entertainment outside, the food and drink of the slaves in the courtyard, the salary of Mr. Tong alone was not enough, so he had to rely on the dowry of the new wife.
Eaters are short-tongued, so there is no need for the new wife to say anything. The masters and servants of the Tong family are all extremely well-behaved, even quick and diligent, for fear that it will be too late to show their loyalty.
Tong Qianqian made trouble several times, but unfortunately she was no match for the new wife's tears in front of Mr. Tong. As soon as Mr. Tong left, her life became even more difficult.
Gradually, she finally knew how to bow her head.
Chapter 22 Living a Happy Life (2)
Not to mention how lively the Tong family is, but in Guiyuan, life is still sweet and peaceful.
It stands to reason that Tong Youyou is the eldest lady of the Tong family, so she will always be affected to some extent by these scandals. But it was almost common knowledge throughout the city that the Tong family treated her harshly in every possible way. After she got married, everyone subconsciously separated her from the Tong family. Some people even felt relieved because she felt sorry for her.
The reputation of the drug store is getting better and better, and what is even more popular is the parenting training in the small yard behind it.
Heirs are always the most valued, whether they are from a wealthy family or ordinary people, especially boys who inherit the family business. If there is no leader in the family, the property will be divided among the clan members in the future, and the married daughter will have no brothers to support and protect her.
Tong Youyou was previously imprisoned in the Tong Family Courtyard in Taizhou with many restrictions, but now she is completely free when she marries the Liang Family's daughter-in-law.
He sat in class for pulse diagnosis in the morning, did personal training in the afternoon, and wrote lesson plans or simple parenting brochures in the evening. He was so busy that Liang Haohai complained countless times, and even said that he regretted asking his wife to open a pharmacy, which made Tong Youyou laugh until her stomach hurt.
But soon, she had to reduce her workload because...she was pregnant!
When Liang Haohai came back from the office that day, he bought donkey meat from the east of the city and burned it. He happily gave it to his wife to eat freshly, but in the end, Tong Youyou vomited half to death.
Doctors don't treat themselves, so Liang Haohai immediately went to the Imperial Hospital to grab an imperial doctor and came back. Only then did he learn the good news.
The couple was so happy that they didn't know when the imperial doctor would be sent away. They finally came to their senses when Aunt Xu and Mrs. Xu arrived with the fat boy in their arms.
Liang Haohai went to the palace to ask for leave again, pestering the emperor to take a year off. He planned to concentrate on accompanying his wife during pregnancy and childbirth.
Needless to say, the emperor gave him a heavy scolding, but also brought him a cart full of supplements, plus half a month's vacation.
Although Tong Youyou specializes in gynecology, she is pregnant for the first time. She was so nervous and excited that it took her several days to calm down.
This was also thanks to the Xu family's sister-in-law and the fat boy, who came to her door almost every day, which made her feel warm in her heart, and naturally she lost her anxiety. Although her grandmother passed away and her mother died young, and her natal family is not the same as hers, the Xu family treats her better than her relatives.
Now that she is pregnant with her own blood, and her husband and wife are loving, she is already a woman that others envy to the point of envy.
The cold winter passed in the days when Tong Youyou ate, slept, ate, and raised a fetus like a pig.
She could only go to the drug store once every three days, and she had to be followed by Liang Haohai before she could go out. Otherwise, a hundred people would come out of Guiyuan to persuade her to stay.
Fortunately, Liang Haohai knew her very well. On days when she couldn't go to the pharmacy, Guiyuan would open its doors to welcome guests, two of them a day. Tong Youyou would help them see a doctor, and they would take the opportunity to relieve Tong Youyou's boredom.
If we talk about the biggest gossip in Kyoto before and after, there is nothing else except that the eldest son of the Annan Marquis Mansion has changed his gender and transformed from a romantic young man to a peerless good husband.
After the New Year, the north wind becomes warmer day by day, melting the winter snow, and the prosperous spring is here.
Farmers are busy cultivating, and the streets in the city are more lively.
It’s the beginning of hot summer in the blink of an eye. After eating the Dragon Boat Festival rice dumplings, July has just entered, and Tong Youyou started to.
She moved around a lot on weekdays and ate healthily. Although it was her first child, she gave birth successfully within an hour.
A fat girl weighing seven and a half kilograms came to the world in the early morning of July 7th, and was destined to fall into the pit of fortune.
The boy from the Xu family was born on the morning of the eighth day of July, and the girl from the Liang family was born one day earlier. Everyone said it was fate.
On July 7th, the Qiao Qiao Festival, the girl from the Liang family had a ready-made baby name, and the word Qiaoer was the most suitable.
Mrs. Xu hugged Qiaoer without letting go. When she saw the red mole between her eyebrows, she felt happy no matter how she looked at it. She repeatedly praised: "This is the Guanyin mole. This child will grow up to be as kind-hearted and smart as her mother."
The women who came to participate in the baptism ceremony also nodded one after another, praised him non-stop, and if they were tempted, they spoke a few words to test.
Mrs. Xu immediately began to protect her, "Qiao'er and my boy's birthdays are only one day apart. We are so destined. I have booked her to be my daughter-in-law, so you can't compete with me."
Although Tong Youyou treats the Xu family just like her natal family, they are not related by blood, and it would not be considered a violation of the rules if the two families are married. Everyone had no excuse and could only watch helplessly as they got closer and closer to each other.
Tong Youyou didn't stop her. The fat boy from the Xu family had a good temper, and the Xu family had a deep relationship with her. If her daughter grew up, she would definitely not be wronged when she married into the Xu family. This world is very different from her previous life. For women, love comes second. How to live a comfortable life without being wronged is even more difficult.
What's more, as time goes by, even if the two children don't see eye to eye, it's not too late to make other arrangements.
Liang Haohai got a fat girl. He was not disappointed as outsiders imagined. Instead, he was so happy that he went crazy with joy. As soon as the full moon came out, he personally carried the girl to the palace to ask for a reward.
The emperor, queen, and even the queen mother did not spare her.
And Qiao'er also tried his best. The child, who was just one month old, was white, plump and cute, with big watery eyes and a rosy cherry mouth. He would smile when he saw anyone but didn't say anything. When he arrived at the Queen Mother's Palace, he hugged the Queen Mother with both hands and bowed before her. This made the eunuchs and maids in the Queen Mother's Palace kneel on the ground. They said bluntly that this girl was a virgin under the Guanyin Seat who descended to earth and bowed to her master when she saw the Queen Mother.
The Queen Mother was so excited that she not only rewarded her with three cartloads of things, but also personally asked the emperor for a princess title and named her Mingyue.
When the news spread, countless people were so envious that their eyes turned red.
Especially in the Annanhou Mansion, Annanhou also has a legitimate daughter, but the emperor has not approved the request for the title of county lord for several years. But here in Guiyuan, a little girl who was just born was directly sealed as Princess Mingyue. It was really a battle between people and people, and it was necessary to compare goods.
But envy is envy, and jealousy continues to be jealous, but no one dares to say an unpleasant word. Because this little girl is now registered with the Emperor and is the Queen Mother’s new favorite. Who dares to mess with her!
In the osmanthus garden, Tong Youyou hugged her daughter and fed her until she was full. Liang Haohai, the slave girl, quickly picked her up and let her lie upright on his shoulders, burping her gently.
When the little girl burped, he felt as if his daughter had saved the world. He was so proud that he praised her repeatedly, wishing that everyone would know about this glorious achievement of his daughter.
Tong Youyou couldn't stand it anymore, the guard commander turned into a fool, and quickly handed her daughter to Sister-in-law Liu to carry her.
Liang Haohai reluctantly watched his daughter go out, then turned around and hugged his wife. Those who didn't know it thought he was too clingy to his daughter-in-law, but in fact he was just filling the remaining empty embrace of his daughter-in-law.
Tong Youyou had such a good temper that she couldn't help but feel jealous and rolled her eyes, making Liang Haohai laugh out loud.
The young couple laughed a little and hugged each other again. They didn't speak for a while, enjoying a rare moment of happiness.
Tong Youyou suddenly remembered something and said: "The day before yesterday's full moon banquet, no one came to the yard over there, but something happened?"
Liang Haohai naturally knew that she was referring to the Tong family, "It's just a small matter. It is said that the colleague from TaizhouThe daughter-in-law colluded and put something in the new wife's anti-fetal medicine, which almost caused the new wife to have a miscarriage. Master Tong was furious and sent his daughter directly to a nunnery outside the city. As for the one in Taizhou, she was probably seriously ill. "
Tong Youyou understands that the so-called serious illness will result in death.
She really didn't know what to say about the mother and daughter. In fact, the new lady didn't necessarily have any intention of getting rid of them. As long as they were peaceful, it wouldn't be difficult to live quietly, but they refused to admit defeat, which led to this ending.
